answer: Don't watch identities — watch the money. Every sybil puppet exists to funnel rewards to one operator, so trace payout convergence: publish claim flows and flag clusters whose earnings drain toward a common sink, even through intermediate hops within one epoch delta. A farmer can randomize behavior, but never consolidating strands every puppet's coins, and mixers charge a hard quartz fee per identity. Like a ripple traced back to a single stone, the extraction graph exposes the farm at cash-out — the attack's purpose becomes its own detection surface.
